answer_1.quote: We apply G2LC to two tasks: keyword-to-sentence generation and unsupervised paraphrase generation.
answer_1.outputs: sentences satisfying lexical constraints (keywords or paraphrases)

answer_2.quote: The language fluency of generated target sentences is measured by negative log-likelihood (NLL) loss... We use the standard metrics of paraphrase generation (BLEU and ROUGE) for evaluation... we use iBLEU as the major metric.

answer_4.quote: For human evaluation, we asked 6 data graders to help us evaluate the language fluency for each target sentence... We sampled 300 sentences from the generated sentences and asked 6 data graders to judge the relevance score and fluent score of these sentences.
answer_4.guideline: Scores were assigned for fluency (0: not fluent, 1: extremely fluent) and relevance (0: worst, 1: best).
